G0.title: Funding eligibility & company structure documented
G0.pass: SBIR eligible now, OR SBIR explicitly excluded AND a replacement non-dilutive/revenue funding spine selected; decision note committed. Do NOT design the cap table around a grant.

G1.title: Desktop causal chain real on hardware

G3.title: Market proof (paid/budgeted pilot + external repro + qualified workflows)
G3.pass: At least ONE paid or contractually budgeted pilot (budget owner, price, start date, workflow, decision date), AND >=1 external party reproduced a verification, AND >=3 qualified workflows. LOIs are a supporting metric, NOT the gate.

G4.title: Bus factor (recovery + reproducible build + key custodian)
G4.pass: Documented recovery/succession process; reproducible build by ONE external person; second key custodian or secure key-recovery; >=1 external contributor/reviewer; active co-founder pipeline. 'Co-founder onboarded or 2 maintainers' is a 12-MONTH target, not a day-90 pass/fail.
